input: Team update: We decided to postpone the Q3 marketing launch from August 15 to September 5 because the new landing page isn't ready. Everything else is on track.
notes: baseline - tests whether the model retains the core decision (postponed) and the new date, not just that something changed

input: Standup notes: (1) Backend: API rate limiting is now deployed to staging. (2) Frontend: the checkout redesign is blocked on design review. (3) Data: the nightly ETL job has been failing for two days due to a schema change upstream.
notes: baseline - three independent bullet items; tests whether the model retains all three under compression instead of dropping one

input: Q2 revenue grew from $2.1M to $2.6M, a 23.8% increase driven mainly by enterprise renewals.
notes: baseline - tests whether the model retains the precise growth number and the stated driver instead of a vague 'grew'

input: The migration to the new payment provider is scheduled for November 12, 2026. All merchants must update their webhook URLs before that date or transactions will fail.
notes: baseline - tests date precision retention plus the required merchant action

input: On July 10, a misconfigured load balancer health check caused 12% of API requests to fail for 40 minutes during peak traffic. The on-call engineer rolled back the load balancer config change at 14:32 UTC, which resolved the incident. A permanent fix - adding a staging canary check before load balancer config changes ship - is planned for next sprint.
notes: baseline - multi-paragraph incident report; tests whether the summary covers cause, resolution, and prevention plan rather than just the outage

input: Acme Corp announced today that it has acquired DataSync Inc. for $340 million in an all-cash deal, expanding Acme's presence in real-time data pipelines.
notes: baseline - proper-noun and dollar-figure retention in an acquisition announcement

input: The team applied the proposed fix for the memory leak, but monitoring over the following 48 hours showed the leak was NOT resolved - memory usage still climbed steadily. The team is investigating a second root cause.
notes: negation-dropping failure mode - naive summaries pattern-match 'applied a fix' into 'the team fixed it' instead of the actual negative outcome stated in the source

input: The checkout page has been returning a 502 error intermittently since this morning. The cause has not yet been identified; the on-call engineer is still investigating logs.
notes: hallucination-bait failure mode - source explicitly states the cause is unknown; a plausible-wrong summary invents a specific cause anyway

input: Initial reports estimated 500 customers were affected by the outage. After a full audit, the actual number was found to be much smaller: only 42 customers experienced any impact.
notes: superseded-information failure mode - source gives a preliminary estimate then corrects it; summary must report the corrected figure as final, not the stale initial estimate. must_exclude deliberately doesn't ban mentioning 500 in an 'initial estimate' framing (order-sensitive substring matching can't tell that apart from a wrong 'outage affected 500' framing) - the required '42' already gates the corrected figure being present

input: After the caching layer was added, average API latency decreased from 420ms to 110ms, a 74% reduction.
notes: direction-of-change failure mode - tests whether the model preserves decrease-vs-increase; a plausible-wrong summary flips the direction while keeping similar-sounding numeric language

input: In the design review, Priya recommended switching to a queue-based architecture to handle traffic spikes. Jordan pushed back, arguing the added operational complexity wasn't worth it for the current scale. No decision was made.
notes: misattribution failure mode - two named people hold opposing positions; summary must keep the position-to-person mapping correct rather than swapping it under compression

input: The new pricing applies only to new customers signing up after January 1, 2027 in the United States; existing customers and international accounts are unaffected.
notes: scope/qualifier-dropping failure mode - source has a narrow eligibility scope (new customers only, one country, one date); an overgeneralized summary drops the qualifier and implies broader applicability

input: The quarterly infrastructure review covered a lot of ground: updated on-call rotation schedules, renewed the CDN contract, reorganized the runbook wiki, and - buried in the appendix - discovered that the primary database backup has been silently failing for three weeks with no alerting in place. The team scheduled a follow-up to fix the backup and alerting gap next week.
notes: critical-detail-in-filler failure mode - a routine-sounding review buries a genuinely urgent finding (silently failing backups) among unrelated administrative items; tests whether the summary surfaces it instead of treating everything as equally weighted filler

input: Of the 47 integration tests run in CI, 42 passed and 5 failed, all five failures traced to the same flaky third-party API mock.
notes: exact-number-preservation failure mode - source gives precise pass/fail counts; tests whether the model keeps the exact figures instead of rounding into vague language ('most passed, a few failed') that loses the actual scale

input: Summarize this in no more than 15 words: The engineering org shipped 34 features, fixed 112 bugs, and reduced average deploy time from 22 minutes to 6 minutes this quarter, while headcount stayed flat at 28 engineers.
notes: length-constraint-compliance failure mode - the source text itself issues a hard word-limit instruction; the standout fact (deploy time improvement) must survive aggressive compression instead of the model padding past the limit or keeping less notable facts instead

input: Customer feedback on the new mobile app has been overwhelmingly negative: users report the redesign removed the search bar, checkout now takes twice as many taps, and the app crashes on startup for roughly 1 in 10 sessions.
notes: sentiment-flipping failure mode - source is unambiguously negative feedback; tests whether the summary preserves the negative framing rather than neutralizing or flipping it toward a diplomatic-sounding tone
